Package edu.ncsu.csc216.wolf_repair.model.manager

Class RepairSite

java.lang.Object
edu.ncsu.csc216.wolf_repair.model.manager.RepairSite
public class RepairSite extends Object
Represents a repair site with a name, category, budget, and work orders. Maintains work orders in ascending order by their identifiers.
Author:
Aanya Tomar

      public void executeCommand(int id, Command c)
